entries.zh: 叙话；交谈、谈论某事
entries.en: to converse, to talk something over

entries.zh: 说大话；夸口（亦指说话傲慢、轻蔑他人）
entries.en: to talk big, to boast; to speak haughtily or with contempt

entries.zh: 说三道四；东拉西扯、闲话不停
entries.en: to gossip, to talk of this and that

entries.zh: 说东说西；信口闲谈、说长道短
entries.en: to chatter indiscriminately, to talk of everything

entries.zh: 说话结巴、舌头打顿；口吃
entries.en: to stammer, to speak haltingly
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（[疑:眠/眼]），释义以西语词头"hablar con paradilla la lengua"（说话舌头打顿）为主

entries.zh: 当言则言；该说话时才说话（劝人慎言）
entries.en: to speak only when it is fitting; speak, sir, when you must
entries.notes: 西语缩写 Vm 依推断展开为 Vuestra merced，且 "si esser vida" 拼写存疑，释义以汉字"當言則言"为主

entries.zh: 极多话的人、健谈者
entries.en: very talkative, a great talker
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（[疑:侒/伶]）且与原稿音写未能完全对应，释义以西语词头"Hablador muy"（极多话）为主

entries.zh: 嘴；借指多嘴多话之人
entries.en: mouth; by metonymy, a talker
entries.notes: 汉字仅"喙"（口），与西语 hablador（多话者）的对应系借代推断

entries.zh: 大声嚷叫、吵嚷；借指多话吵闹者
entries.en: to shout, to clamor; a loud bawler
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（嗲/哮），据原稿音写与西语 hablador 释为嚷叫多话

entries.zh: 撒谎、说大话的嘴；指说话不实之人
entries.en: a lying, boastful mouth; liar, braggart

entries.zh: 说话滑溜利落、口若悬河（的人）
entries.en: a glib talker whose tongue runs on without stop

entries.zh: 极滑溜；说话油滑、油嘴滑舌
entries.en: very slick and glib in speech

entries.zh: 杂才人；样样都能说、能说会道的人
entries.en: a man of assorted talents; a versatile, glib talker
entries.notes: "雜才"本义杂学多能，与 hablador（多话者）的对应依赖推断

entries.zh: 口舌多；多嘴多舌（的人）
entries.en: many mouths and tongues; very talkative

entries.zh: 多口；嘴多、爱说话（的人）
entries.en: many mouths; talkative

entries.zh: 口利；口齿伶俐、能言善辩（指胜人一筹的健谈者）
entries.en: sharp-tongued, exceptionally quick and glib of speech

entries.zh: 多口；嘴多话多（的人）
entries.en: many mouths; talkative

entries.zh: 喋喋不休、夸夸其谈的人
entries.en: a chatterbox, babbler
entries.notes: 汉字"波年"与原稿音写无法互证，仅据西语词头"hablador, charlatan"释义，存疑

entries.zh: 破口；开口便骂、信口喧嚷（指多话吵闹者）
entries.en: to break out in speech or cursing; a railing chatterer

entries.zh: 嚣张自得；自高自大、自以为是的夸夸其谈者
entries.en: an arrogant self-satisfied boaster, proud of what he thinks he knows
entries.notes: 末音节原稿污損难辨（T99），汉字仅"囂自得"三字，释义以西语词头为主，存疑
